content.content: The exclude interface writes by appending: the recorded entry becomes a line at the end of the contents the read returned, and a file whose last line lacks a terminating newline gains one first.
content.rationale: The whole-file read (S2-exclude-read, xpxukylv) is what the write operates on; the append is the separate commitment about the write's form. Appending one line keeps git's own template intact — the file is git's, not deccy's. A whole-file replacement would have to reproduce the template exactly, which the interface has no business owning. Whether an entry is already present, and so should not be appended again, is the caller's call (IN-record-idempotent, vnsyvzpp); the append writes what it is given.
